masters-vo2max-lifelong.label: VO₂max in men, lifelong exercisers (74 y) against young exercisers (25 y) and non-exercisers (75 y)

hrmax-decline-athletes.label: Fall in maximal heart rate with age in athletes
hrmax-decline-athletes.value: about 0.7 beats·min⁻¹ per year (5–7 per decade), whatever the training

muscle-loss-75.label: Loss of strength and mass at age 75 (longitudinal studies)
muscle-loss-75.value: strength 3–4% per year in men, 2.5–3% in women; mass 0.8–1.0% and 0.6–0.7% per year; strength falls 2–5 times faster

older-protein-per-meal.label: Protein per meal to reach the plateau of muscle protein synthesis, older against young men
older-protein-per-meal.value: about 0.40 g·kg⁻¹ against 0.24 g·kg⁻¹ (a borderline difference, p = 0.055)
